steps.name: Next-Seed Pre-Commitment Chain
steps.detail: 33/33 transitions between successive epochs of the same capture: nextHashedServerSeed == next epoch's hashedServerSeed (chain INTACT within each of the 3 captures; no link between captures is recorded or claimed — each capture is its own run with its own anchor); 36/36 seed records carry the capture and capture-epoch of the plan (src/pins.ts EPOCH_PLAN); pre-capture link, one per capture: reveal→commitment 3/3, chains into the capture's first epoch 3/3; recorded order (capture clock, the order the capture RECORDED — not an operator-side event order): 36/36 epochs' commitment recorded before their first bet (the capture's pre-capture record for its first epoch, the previous seed record's next-hash after that), 36/36 seed records written before their epoch's first bet, 33/33 rotations (the next seed record of the same capture) written after the retiring epoch's last bet (the closing rotation of each capture's last epoch is not a seed record and is not timed); on LIQD's clock (the HTTP Date header of LIQD's own replies, one-second resolution): 36/36 epochs' commitment published in a reply dated no later than the rotation reply that sent the epoch's client seed — 35 strictly earlier, 1 in the same second (epoch 0 (capture 1, pre-capture seed read and rotation both dated Sun, 08 Nov 2026 22:36:19 GMT))

profileChecks.note: the dataset holds three captures, each its own run. Within a capture every rotation is recomputed from the raw fields (seeds[i].nextHashedServerSeed == seeds[i+1].hashedServerSeed): EXPECTED_CHAIN_LINKS = 33 transitions (24 + 9 + 0), never from the capture's own chainLinkOk / commitVerified booleans. Each capture has its own pre-capture anchor (meta.captures[].preCapture), asserted in both halves — its revealed seed hashes to its commitment and its next hash is the capture's first epoch — and an absent anchor FAILs. No link between captures is recorded or claimed: other games were played on the account between the runs. The recorded order (commitment before first bet, seed record before first bet, reveal after last bet) is asserted on the capture's own clock

steps.name: Nonce Audit
steps.detail: 36/36 epochs: single client seed each, nonces in capture order, unique, and exactly the DECLARED window [0, 0 + size − 1] of the epoch (NONCE_BASE 0 and the epoch sizes 100, 124, 190, 200 are code constants in src/pins.ts EPOCH_PLAN: capture 1 A 25 × 200; capture 2 D 5 × 100, A+ 5 × 190; capture 3 C 1 × 124 — not the minimum observed, and not the seed records' own nonceStart/nonceEnd, which are checked AGAINST the declaration: 0 disagreements). Gaps: 0 found, 0 capture-retry gap(s) declared. The window is what the capture requested under each seed, not an operator-side counter: this establishes that the bet rows are complete against it, not that no other nonce was ever served (selective orphaning — see MANIFEST.md#dataset-and-capture). No gaps in any epoch.

profileChecks.note: the client-seed half: every epoch carries exactly one client seed

per epoch the nonces are exactly NONCE_BASE … NONCE_BASE + size − 1 in capture order, with no gap, repeat or reorder, where size is the epoch's length in the plan (src/pins.ts EPOCH_PLAN: 200, 100, 190 or 124). A gap is counted against EXPECTED_CAPTURE_RETRY_GAPS (0): an undeclared gap FAILs, a declared one would be a capture-origin FLAG

Draw bias bound (declared design: rejection sampling, src/rng.ts maxFairFor): maxFair per range [range:maxFair] 25:4294967275 24:4294967280 23:4294967284 22:4294967292 21:4294967292 20:4294967280 19:4294967290 18:4294967292 17:4294967295 16:4294967296 15:4294967295 14:4294967292 13:4294967287 12:4294967292 11:4294967292 10:4294967290 9:4294967292 8:4294967296 7:4294967292 6:4294967292 5:4294967295 4:4294967296 3:4294967295 2:4294967296 1:4294967296; 25/25 ranges have maxFair a whole multiple of the range, so the per-value bias conditional on acceptance is exactly 0 (worst over all ranges 0; bound 2^-32 = 2.328e-10); per-draw rejection probability (2^32 − maxFair)/2^32 is at most 4.889e-9 (range 25). steps.name: House Edge / RTP Audit (closed-form identity, per-config, anti-circular)
steps.detail: Closed-form identity theoreticalRTP(m,k) = winProbability(m,k) × minesMultiplierExact(m,k) (winProbability = pure C(25-m,k)/C(25,k) combinatorics), checked for m=1..24 at k=1 and the 20 multi-reveal settings (src/pins.ts PROD_DEPTHS) — 44/44 cases: RTP range 99.0000%–99.0000%, mean 99.0000% — a clean 99.0000% for every (m,k) (closed-form edge exactly 1.00%), because the exact multiplier makes the CLOSED FORM identically (1 − edge) — the settlement floor can reduce the return, quantified next. Full-grid reference sweep: all 300/300 legal (m,k) cells (k=1..25−m) evaluate to 99.0000% within 1e-9 (0 off), range 99.0000%–99.0000% — this checks the reference formula at every reachable depth, NOT the operator (40/300 cells were played on production, Steps 8 and 22; 260 formula-only). Settlement floor — the identity above is the THEORETICAL leg; the amounts LIQD writes are floored, so the return they carry is at most (1 − edge). (a) the BOOKED fiat amount, floor2(stake × exact), at the smallest stake played (0.10, DERIVED from the 2 distinct betAmount value(s) in the pinned bets — 0.10, 10.00 — not read from meta.phases; the header's own smallest amount is 0.10 and the two agree): worst cell over all 300 m=1,k=2, 7.0000 pp of turnover → a booked return of 92.0000% there — a property of a cent-floored figure at a 0.10 stake, not of the wallet field (Step 8 states the amounts dropped per capture); (b) the USDT wallet field in the reply, LIQD's measured rule floor8(walletStake × floor8(exact)) (Step 22), at the smallest betAmountWallet in the raw captures (0.07084688 USDT, a 0.10 CAD stake of capture 1): worst cell m=1,k=4, 1.016e-7 of turnover → RTP on the wallet field 98.999990%, i.e. 99.0000% to four decimals; (c) the BOOKED amount at the smallest stake LIQD serves (minBet 0.01 in every settings record, src/pins.ts PROD_GAME_SETTINGS; not played): worst cell m=3,k=5, 49.4348 pp of turnover → a booked return of 49.5652% there. Which of the booked amount and the wallet field reaches the balance is not verified (no balance was read, MANIFEST DL-5). Edge-rational integrity: EDGE_NUM/EDGE_DEN = 99000000/100000000 exactly represents (1 − HOUSE_EDGE) = 0.99 — the BigInt factor the floor8 wallet field identity in Step 8 divides by. A factor that only approximates the audited edge makes that identity measure a different edge, silently. Reference-formula integrity: 0 cells returned a non-finite value — a NaN/Infinity here is NOT an "off 99%" deviation (which FLAGs); it means the auditor's own reference is corrupt and every comparison built on it is vacuous, so it hard-FAILS. This is the uncapped reference calculation; Step 8 checks the booked winningAmount and Step 22 the wallet field in the reply at the 40 played cells. The displayed multiplier field is floored — cosmetic (Step 7). Monotonicity (FLAG policy, scored): the exact multiplier is strictly increasing in depth and in mine count over 552/552 adjacent legal cell pairs (exact rational comparison) — 0 violations. Caps (MINES-14 cap half, MANIFEST DL-7) — DISCLOSED, NOT SCORED since 2026-10-15: payout caps are excluded from the audit and multiplier caps stay in scope (profile owner, 2026-10-15); LIQD states that Mines has had no multiplier cap since the end of August 2026 (the 10,000× setting removed from the configuration) and that a per-round payout limit ends the round and pays the full multiplier for the tiles already revealed (operator statement, 2026-10-15, quoted in MANIFEST DL-7). Production build: 3886 of the 6574 settling replies carry currentGameSettings (every loss and the 3 wins LIQD settled by itself; a cash-out reply carries none), 3 distinct value(s), 0 with a maxOdds key — no multiplier cap, as stated; the values equal the declaration src/pins.ts PROD_GAME_SETTINGS (capture 1: 413 × maxBet 7060 / maxExposure 70600; capture 1: 2608 × maxBet 7050 / maxExposure 70500; capture 2: 850 × maxBet 5000 / maxExposure 50000; capture 3: 15 × maxBet 5000 / maxExposure 50000; the limits are stated in the fiat the round was booked in, CAD in capture 1 and USD in captures 2 and 3, with maxExposureUsdc 50000 in all), which Step 22 binds to the raw captures; maxExposure is the round payout limit LIQD describes, excluded (payout-limit enforcement is not tested; no captured round reached it). Largest multiplier displayed on a production win: 40.86× (2691/2691 wins carry a finite displayed multiplier); the reference formula exceeds 10,000× at 44 of the 300 legal cells, none played; the live page read 2026-10-01 quotes 5,148,297× (evidence/rtp-page-labels-2026-10-01.json): the top multiplier on the formula (m=12, k=13), payable only within the round payout limit — CAD limit 70,500: a full clear at the 0.01 minimum books 51,482.97 CAD, within it; from a stake of 0.02 CAD a full clear exceeds it; CAD limit 70,600: a full clear at the 0.01 minimum books 51,482.97 CAD, within it; from a stake of 0.02 CAD a full clear exceeds it; USD limit 50,000: a full clear at the 0.01 minimum would book 51,482.97 USD, above it; by LIQD's statement of 15 October 2026 a 12-mine round at that stake ends at 12 tiles, 396,022.85× (booked 3,960.22 USD) (arithmetic on the served settings; payout-limit enforcement was not observed). RTP claim — RULING 1 (decided): LIQD is held to the page's flat 99.00% ("99% RTP at every setting"; scored by the RTP-CLAIM gate printed after the steps), which the wallet field meets (99.0000% to four decimals, (b) above). DISCREPANCY, as published on 1 Oct 2026: the same page states "Multipliers are rounded to two decimals rather than cut, so the realised edge moves a little with the exact mines-and-picks combination, between 0.64% and 1.44%, around the nominal 1%." (RTP 98.56%–99.36%). On production the displayed multiplier is cut, not rounded (Step 7), and the range matches neither rule: over the 300 cells, paying the 2-decimal multiplier cut would give an edge of 1.00%–1.72%, rounded 0.56%–1.33%. Run through the same rule (RTP-CLAIM 1.2.0, band 0.10 pp) as a range claim the sentence would FAIL: published min 98.560000% vs true 99.000000% (-0.440000 pp, FAIL); published max 99.360000% vs true 99.000000% (0.360000 pp, FAIL). Printed as the discrepancy, not scored. FLAG REASONS: none.

the identity half of anti-circularity: P(survive k) × multiplier(m,k) == 1 − edge at all 300 cells with no operator data; a non-finite reference value FAILs as its own fault class

the effective edge is derived per cell over all 300 cells against the published claim, and the two settlement floors are quantified in BigInt: the booked cent floor at the smallest stake played and the wallet rule at the smallest wallet stake in the raw captures. The RTP-CLAIM gate holds the per-setting table to the claim shown to players. RULING 1 (11 November 2026): LIQD is held to the page's flat 99%, which the wallet field meets; the page's rounding sentence is recorded as a discrepancy, as published on 1 Oct 2026

steps.name: Client Seed Variation (Phase D player-set seeds; seed order on every epoch)
steps.detail: PHASE D: 500/500 rounds in 5 epochs under 5 distinct player-set client seeds (floor 2; declared 5, src/pins.ts): pfaudit-prod-mines-d1-d55af3b7500b, pfaudit-prod-mines-d2-3d366d3d6119, pfaudit-prod-mines-d3-a2cf086b27a0, pfaudit-prod-mines-d4-7db3c7d5315c, pfaudit-prod-mines-d5-c67740e147b2; 500/500 rounds carry their epoch's player-set seed; mine-layout recomputation under it: 500/500 match (500/500 recomputed); 5/5 seeds of the declared form "pfaudit-prod-mines-d<k>-" + 12 hex digits with k the epoch's position; 5/5 named for their epoch in the capture's meta, written before its anchor rotation; 5/5 submitted in a rotation recorded as player-set and not predictable; 5/5 returned by LIQD's rotation reply as the active client seed (taken by the site); 0 uses of a player-set seed outside Phase D. WHOLE DATASET: 6574 rounds, 36 distinct client seeds across 36 epochs; recomputation under each round's own client seed: 6574/6574 match. Predictable-seed census (a client seed carrying a 13-digit millisecond timestamp): 0 epochs. Order, from the raw captures' rotation records (the capture's clock, not an operator-side order): 36/36 epochs' client seeds were submitted in the rotation whose reply made that epoch's commitment active, recorded before the epoch's first bet; 36/36 of those rotations record the generator and mark it not predictable. The server seed was therefore committed before the client seed it was used with was submitted. steps.name: Simulation — Pass 2 Cherry-Pick Test
steps.detail: 36 revealed dataset seeds × 10,000 nonces; early window 0..99 (src/pins.ts PASS2_EARLY_WINDOW 100: the first 100 nonces, the longest prefix every epoch played in full — epoch lengths 100, 124, 190, 200; the later nonces of the longer epochs fall in the late window, and the served-configuration test below covers each epoch's whole captured range). Recalculated early/late statistics and late p-values: 0 mismatching rows; epoch and mine-count mismatches: 0, 0. Flags derived from earlyBootstrapP < 0.05 and latePValue >= 0.05: 4; nominal expectation 1.710, binomial survival 0.08989253; 0 stored-flag mismatches. Bootstrap replay: 10,000 replicates per mine count rebuilt from the recorded master seed under 'mines-seed-derivation-v1'; 36/36 p-values checked, 0 mismatches. Unsupported, partial or malformed replay metadata fails verification. This first-draw diagnostic does not prove unbiased seed selection. SERVED-CONFIG TEST (the configurations each epoch actually served, mine count and requested tiles by nonce, replayed over its revealed seed): 36/36 epochs, each over 200 of its own lengths (100 → 20,000 nonces, 124 → 24,800 nonces, 190 → 38,000 nonces, 200 → 40,000 nonces; floor 10,000); early window = the epoch's captured nonces 0 … size − 1, its replayed outcomes bound to the 6,574 recorded outcomes of 6,574 (0 mismatches); statistic = window return against the exact per-config mean and variance; bootstrap p against the seed's own 199 later windows: 0/36 epochs flagged at p ≤ 0.01 (family gate ≤ 3 at family α 0.001); pooled early-window return 6523.3334 vs exact expectation 6508.2600, z = 0.088 (gate −3.09); detection power of the pooled test 11.5% at a 5% early-window return shortfall, 75.6% at a 10% early-window return shortfall, 100.0% at a 20% early-window return shortfall. Rule fixed in code (SERVED_* constants) before the statistic was computed on production data. Each round's tiles are its planned order from the raw captures (drawn by the runner's CSPRNG, written into the plan before any bet), of which every recorded opened sequence is a prefix, so the tiles a losing round did not reach are the ones it was going to open. Mitigation against selecting a server seed for a known client input requires a binding server commitment before learning an unpredictable client seed, with both inputs bound to the round. Player control alone does not establish those conditions.

profileChecks.note: every revealed seed (36). The profile's statistic is the served-configuration test: each epoch's captured configurations, in nonce order with each round's planned tiles from the raw captures, are replayed over the revealed seed for 200 of the epoch's own lengths (20,000 to 40,000 nonces, floor 10,000); the early window is exactly the epoch's captured nonce range and its replayed outcomes must equal the recorded ones; the window return is ranked against the seed's own later windows; the rule is pre-registered in code and the detection power is printed.
